cases.sentence: Можно было, опровергнув ___, удержать прежнее воззрение на историю, но, не опровергнув их, нельзя было, казалось, продолжать изучать исторические события, как произведение свободной воли людей.
cases.explain: «новые законы» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: By refuting these new laws the former view of history might have been retained; but without refuting them it would seem impossible to continue studying historic events as the results of man’s free will. For if a certain mode of government was established or certain migrations of peoples took place in consequence of such and such geographic, ethnographic, or economic conditions, then the free will of those individuals who appear to us to have established that mode of government or occasioned the migrations can no longer be regarded as the cause.

cases.sentence: Долго и упорно шла в ___ борьба между старым и новым взглядом.
cases.explain: «физической философии» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: The struggle between the old views and the new was long and stubbornly fought out in physical philosophy. Theology stood on guard for the old views and accused the new of violating revelation. But when truth conquered, theology established itself just as firmly on the new foundation.

cases.sentence: Богословие стояло на страже за ___ и обвиняло новый в разрушении откровения.
cases.explain: «старый взгляд» — after the preposition «за», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The struggle between the old views and the new was long and stubbornly fought out in physical philosophy. Theology stood on guard for the old views and accused the new of violating revelation. But when truth conquered, theology established itself just as firmly on the new foundation.

cases.sentence: Но когда истина победила, богословие построилось так же твердо на ___.
cases.explain: «новой почве» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: The struggle between the old views and the new was long and stubbornly fought out in physical philosophy. Theology stood on guard for the old views and accused the new of violating revelation. But when truth conquered, theology established itself just as firmly on the new foundation.

cases.sentence: Так же долго и упорно идет борьба в настоящее время между старым и новым воззрением на историю и точно так же богословие стоит на страже за ___ и обвиняет новый в разрушении откровения.
cases.explain: «старый взгляд» — after the preposition «за», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Just as prolonged and stubborn is the struggle now proceeding between the old and the new conception of history, and theology in the same way stands on guard for the old view, and accuses the new view of subverting revelation.

cases.sentence: Как в том, так и в ___ с обеих сторон борьба вызывает страсти и заглушает истину.
cases.explain: «другом случае» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: In the one case as in the other, on both sides the struggle provokes passion and stifles truth. On the one hand there is fear and regret for the loss of the whole edifice constructed through the ages, on the other is the passion for destruction.

cases.sentence: Как в вопросе астрономии тогда, как и теперь в вопросе истории, всё различие воззрения основано на признании или непризнании ___, служащей мерилом видимых явлений.
cases.explain: «абсолютной единицы» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: As in the question of astronomy then, so in the question of history now, the whole difference of opinion is based on the recognition or nonrecognition of something absolute, serving as the measure of visible phenomena. In astronomy it was the immovability of the earth, in history it is the independence of personality—free will.
